texts.headline: Gale, yellow level, Stoett - Loedingen, 2026-11-06T10:00:00+00:00, 2026-11-07T10:00:00+00:00
texts.description: From Friday late morning south west occasional near gale force 7. Occasional weakening Friday afternoon.
texts.instruction: Consider not taking the boat out: Risk of dangerous situations when in a small boat at sea. If the engine stops you can float towards land.

parameters.name: impacts
parameters.value: Sea heaps up: Moderate amounts of airborne spray. Moderately high waves: Waves with breaking crests forming spindrift. Considerable airborne spray.
